item.title: Change Data Capture on a Simulated Online Shop with Debezium and Kafka Connect
item.description: Most databases change all day: users sign up, orders are placed, and each order moves from one status to the next. Change data capture (CDC) turns those changes into a stream of events that other systems can read as they happen. In this post, a simulated online shop writes to PostgreSQL in real time, Debezium streams every change to Kafka, and a sink connector saves the changes as files in object storage. Everything runs on your own machine.
